text:
sam: Quick poll 1 day-trip escape this weekend 1 where would you go within 2 hours of the city? Lists and one-sentence reasons, go! :airplane:

anya: Coastal lighthouse hike. Salt air + cliff views = instant reset. :ocean:

diego: Antique fair in a small town. Treasure hunting + espresso. :coffee:

mira: Reservoir kayak loop. Quiet water, bring sandwiches. :kayak:

oliver: Local vineyard for a slow afternoon and terrible tasting notes. :wine_glass:

stella: Botanical gardens + picnic blanket. Low effort, high plant density. :herb:

calendar-bot: Reminder: public transit strike tomorrow; check schedules before planning. :warning:

sam: Nice variety. Anyone up for a quick vote? React to pick: :ocean: lighthouse, :coffee: antique fair, :kayak: kayaking, :wine_glass: vineyard, :herb: gardens.

anya: :ocean:

diego: :coffee:

mira: :kayak:

stella: :herb:

oliver: :wine_glass: (but only if someone drives)

sam: Looks like it's close! Tally: ocean, coffee, kayak, herb, wine all in play. I'll DM a quick poll and see who can go Saturday vs Sunday. Thanks team for quick ideas. :smile:

mira: If anyone wants to borrow a kayak paddle, I have an extra. Ping me. :handshake:
